_note: claude-code exposes four user-facing transport types in settings JSON: stdio, sse, http, ws. InProcess and SdkControl are internal-only and never round-trip through user/project/managed settings. SseIde/WsIde (oracle sse-ide/ws-ide) are members of the PLUGIN mcpServers union and are managed by the local /ide controller. PosixMcpTransport::connect() claims Stdio/Sse/Http/SseIde/WsIde; generic WebSocket remains available through the dedicated connect_ws helper. The fixture documents the categorisation; the driver below builds each spec variant programmatically and asserts the production transport's response.
